plan_reference: docs/plans/vhf-cryosection-machine-driven-plan.md section 2.7 (terminal status without an anatomist), 2.4 (reserved evaluation), 2.1 (Denver floor H_c, P_c), 9 (decision rule); roadmap section 6b
pre_registration: written before any training run of the pilot; the criteria, controls, thresholds and status rules below are fixed; any change after a result has been seen is version 2, and every result already scored stays reported under version 1

scope.region: Denver block 2, mid-thigh to pelvis: Denver slices k 2285..3532 (z 760.6 to 1175.8 mm, VHF-image-2022), the block without rotation and with one photograph offset

classes_not_assessable_by_construction.ligament-tendon: no Denver ligament voxel in the block (Denver ligaments are the knee ligaments)
classes_not_assessable_by_construction.fat: no Denver source in the 2022 release

scope.use: tissue-class segmentation of the colour cryosections (class level, no instances, no names); the result speaks for this block, these classes and this use only
scope.network: nnU-Net v2, 2D configuration, fold 0 of the frozen split (training slices of registry/cryo-eval-bands-v1.json); the variant and fold are part of the frozen result identity

statuses.machine-accepted: a frozen prediction volume that meets every criterion of its class below and for which every negative control behaves as required; no human anatomical review; never called validation
statuses.machine-failed: a frozen prediction volume that is assessable and misses at least one criterion of its class; the failing criterion is named
statuses.machine-not-assessable: the class has no reference support in the scoring slices (below min_reference_voxels), or a negative control did not behave as required (the evaluation itself is then not trusted for any class), or the input hashes do not match this protocol
statuses.separate_states: technical acceptance (this protocol) / name (pending, not applicable at class level) / placement (the block is in Denver's frame by construction; the alignment uncertainty is that of transforms/nlm-cryosection-to-vhf.json, residual below 0.1 px in this block)

reference.labels: Denver ORIGINAL label maps (VHF_Full.mat) of the scoring slices, mapped through registry/cryo-tissue-map.json version 1; never the voxelised final meshes
reference.scoring_slices: slices of the two frozen bands of registry/cryo-eval-bands-v1.json whose pair status is usable or usable-flagged (141 + 150 = 291 slices); excluded-identity and excluded-observability slices inside a band are not scored
reference.ignore: voxels with tissue class 255 (unknown inside the body, whole excluded slices) are outside every metric, numerator and denominator; background (0) is not a class under acceptance
reference.training_never_sees: band slices and their 10 mm buffers (registry/cryo-eval-bands-v1.json, training_k_ranges is the only source of training slices)

noise_floor.meaning: agreement between Denver's original label maps and Denver's final meshes per structure, class median (plan B 2.1): the effect of Denver's post-processing, not human variability and not a bound on anatomical truth

metrics.dice: per class, voxels pooled over all scoring slices of both bands (the 2D predictions stacked into one volume), ignore excluded; also reported per band and on usable-only slices (sensitivity rows, no criterion)
metrics.surface_p95_mm: 95th percentile of the symmetric surface distance between the pooled prediction mask and the pooled reference mask of the class, in mm, spacing 0.666 x 0.666 x 0.333, computed as in scripts/denver-noise-floor.py (surface voxels, nearest-neighbour distance both ways, pooled percentile)
metrics.granularity_caveat: H_c is a median of per-structure Dice; the pilot scores one union per tissue class, which does not see confusions between neighbouring structures of the same tissue; a class Dice at H_c is therefore a weaker statement than per-structure concordance, and the report says so next to every figure

bone.rule: Dice >= H_bone and p95 <= P_bone (plan B 2.2, bone and muscle rows); Dice is the primary figure of the plan B 9 decision rule, p95 the secondary; a class that passes Dice and fails p95 is machine-failed with reason surface

muscle.rule: Dice >= H_muscle - 0.03 (roadmap 6b, plan B 9: within 0.03 of H_c) and p95 <= P_muscle; same primary/secondary reading as bone

cartilage.rule: p95 <= P_cartilage only; Dice reported, not a criterion (thin structure, H_cartilage 0.59 says Dice is not informative, plan B 2.2 cartilage row)
cartilage.note: cartilage reference exists in band 1 only (55,653 voxels on scoring slices); band 2 is machine-not-assessable for cartilage by construction and the pooled figure is band 1

negative_controls.purpose: each control transforms the frozen prediction or the reference in a way that must degrade the score; a control that does not degrade it means the metric or the pairing is broken and every class becomes machine-not-assessable for that evaluation

mirror.operation: prediction mirrored about the Denver i axis (i -> 665 - i) on every scoring slice
mirror.required: Dice lower than the unmirrored prediction by at least 0.05 for bone and for muscle
mirror.why_0_05: the pelvis is roughly bilaterally symmetric and the Denver frame is roughly centred, so a mirrored gluteal muscle still overlaps its contralateral; the margin separates a real prediction from a symmetric blob

shift.operation: prediction shifted by +3 Denver pixels along i (2.0 mm, the 6 photograph pixels of the Codex RGB review controls) on every scoring slice
shift.required: Dice strictly lower and p95 strictly higher than the unshifted prediction for every assessed class

dilation.operation: prediction dilated by 3 Denver pixels in-plane (2.0 mm) on every scoring slice
dilation.required: Dice strictly lower and p95 strictly higher than the undilated prediction for every assessed class

wrong_neighbour.operation: the reference of slice k replaced by the Denver labels of slice k + 30 (10 mm) where k + 30 lies inside the same band and is a scoring slice; scored as if it were the prediction
wrong_neighbour.required: Dice of the wrong neighbour against the true reference lower than the model's Dice for every assessed class; if the model does not beat a 10 mm-displaced copy of Denver, it has learnt nothing the neighbour did not already say

fixed_at_evaluation: nnU-Net v2 version and git revision
identity_by_hash.rule: an evaluation whose fixed_now hashes differ from this file is machine-not-assessable under version 1; a new manifest, map or band file means version 2

iteration_limit.rule: at most two training runs per variant under version 1 (the second only for a technical failure of the first: crash, non-convergence, wrong input); every run is listed in the report with its status; a third run or any change to data, map, bands, thresholds or controls after seeing a score is version 2

report.file: generated/cryo-pilot-acceptance-block2.json (written by the evaluation script of stage 6; does not exist yet)
must_contain: per variant and per class: Dice pooled, per band, usable-only; p95 pooled, per band; every control figure; status and the reason
closure: the lists machine-accepted, machine-failed, machine-not-assessable, none omitted
the difference between variants per class (what the CT prior channel adds), reported without a criterion
the granularity caveat and the limits below, verbatim or by reference

decision_rule_plan_b_9: plan B proceeds to the first block without labels (the trunk above the pelvis, with its own alignment protocol first) if, in at least one variant, bone is machine-accepted and muscle is machine-accepted (Dice within 0.03 of H_muscle); otherwise the assisted-annotation phase C of plan A with the same proofs; the decision is the user's and is recorded, this file only states the rule agreed in advance
limits: concordance with Denver's original labels on 291 held-out slices of one block; never anatomical accuracy, never validation
class level: structure confusions inside a tissue are invisible; H_c was measured per structure
usable-flagged pairs (whole-frame identity only) are scored together with usable pairs; the usable-only row shows the sensitivity
Denver's labels are the reference, not the truth: a Denver labelling error counts against the model
observability was measured only at the block-boundary bands; a non-observable slice elsewhere would count against the model too
the CT prior variant carries the fresh-CT placement error of the pelvis (3 to 5 mm) into its input channel; nothing is corrected
inspected and batch-audited are never granted by this protocol (reserved for the optional stage 8)
